snippet.title: Knight George - Steam Page Trailer
snippet.description:
Knight George is a top-down retro-style action-adventure game. Travel across the Kingdom of Earlyne to meet friendly characters, explore numerous dungeons and fight terrifying monsters to save the kingdom!

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4305040/Knight_George/
Itch page: https://linky439.itch.io/knight-george


Stay tuned for more information about the game!
